semantic_definition.groove: dark/sunken longitudinal boundary used to define a corridor
semantic_definition.main_flesh_band: elongated fleshy pattern running along the fruit axis; may be composed of multiple separated fragments that still form one longitudinal pattern
semantic_definition.wart_flesh: small/local rounded fleshy protrusion that does not form a sufficiently long longitudinal band pattern
semantic_definition.important: all raised flesh is segmented first; main-vs-wart is assigned after segmentation using geometry and longitudinal grouping

method.edge: dark-only edge/groove evidence with glare suppression
method.primitive_segmentation: dark barrier + flesh hysteresis + morphological reconstruction
method.sam3: per-primitive refinement; semantic text masks are weak audit evidence only
method.semantic_grouping: geometry + fragment graph grouping; no breakpoint prediction
